rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for harm or hurt, including physical and emotional harm.

example.english: Smoking is a detriment to your health.
example.jyutping: kap1 jin1 deoi3 gin6 hong1 jau5 soeng1 hoi6

rows.note: Use this for damage to property, interests, reputation, or other concrete things, especially in formal contexts.

example.english: This scandal was a serious detriment to the company’s reputation.
example.traditional: 呢單醜聞對公司聲譽造成好大損害。
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 cau2 man4 deoi3 gung1 si1 sing1 jyu6 zou6 sing4 hou2 daai6 syun2 hoi6
